name: brand-kit-os-leafpad
description: Brand context, voice enforcement, and Leafpad blog publishing for Claude — powered by Brand Kit OS.
author: Nicolas Thatcher

brand_kit_api_key.description: Your Brand Kit OS API key (get one at https://brandkitos.com/settings → API Keys)

publish_mode.description: Default publishing behavior for /publish-pipeline. 'draft' creates an unpublished post you review in Leafpad; 'published' goes live immediately. For AI-scheduled future posts (Leafpad generates the content at a target date), use the separate /ai-schedule command — Leafpad has no publish-at-date for hand-crafted drafts.
